title: 第176章 “帮我摘掉。”
slug: 万一小叔对假千金是柏拉图呢
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

不仅教她换气。

男人将她揽在怀中，咬着她的耳垂：“拢紧。”

祝砚铮这个混蛋！！

真这么难耐，倒是、倒是别一直这样折磨她啊！

祝砚铮自然听不见少女的心声。

他咬着她的唇舌，墨瞳浓得化不开。

大片红痕。

宋瓷被磋磨着，全身重量的支撑点只有男人的一双手。

他托着她，不由分说。

比真的还要，更直观的……

宋瓷低头看了一眼，又慌乱地将眼神错开。

男人看到了她的动作。

吻着她的动作“大发慈悲”地停下，转而压着她的下巴，迫她垂头。

过于直观了些，宋瓷看得眼晕。

“看它。”

男人嗓音喑哑，又去吻她的脖颈与肩膀。

“宋瓷，是因为你。”

宋瓷也不清楚自己是什么时候睡着了。

半梦半醒间，她感觉到有人在给她抹药膏。

冷凉的药膏触感落在她的肌肤上，大腿上的红痕与炽热都被掩盖了干净。

温热的毛巾擦拭过她的身体，清理干净。

宋瓷想要睁开眼睛看清面前的男人，但到底抵不过疲倦与困意，沉沉睡去。

第二天，宋瓷睡到了十一点半。

她是在祝砚铮的房间里醒过来的，醒来时，身边就放着干净崭新的衣物。

昨晚的睡裙早就不能要了，真丝的面料满是褶皱与……不堪。

房间里已经收拾过了，从内到外的衣物都给她准备齐全了。

宋瓷穿好衣服，走出房门时，就看到了坐在客厅里，低头看报的祝砚铮。

微微挑眉。

今天不是工作日吗？祝砚铮没去公司？

腿还有些软。

宋瓷扶着扶手，站在了楼梯上。

听到动静，男人微微抬眸，朝她看去。

少女洗漱整理完毕，容光焕发，脸色红润。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Not only teach her to breathe.

The man held her in his arms and bit her earlobe: "Hold tight."

Zhu Yanzheng, this bastard!!

It's so unbearable, but don't keep torturing her like this!

Zhu Yanzheng naturally couldn't hear the girl's voice.

He bit her lips and tongue, his dark eyes so thick that they couldn't be opened.

Large red marks.

Song Ci was being rubbed, and the only support point for his body weight was the man's hands.

He held her in his arms and couldn't help but say something.

It's even more intuitive than the real thing...

Song Ci glanced down, then looked away in panic.

The man saw her actions.

He stopped kissing her "mercifully" and instead pressed her chin, forcing her to lower her head.

It was too intuitive, and Song Ci felt dizzy.

"Look at it."

The man's voice was hoarse and he kissed her neck and shoulders again.

"Song Ci, it's because of you."

Song Ci didn't know when she fell asleep.

Half asleep, she felt someone applying ointment to her.

The cold ointment fell on her skin, and the red marks and heat on her thighs were covered up.

The warm towel wiped her body and cleaned it.

Song Ci wanted to open her eyes and see the man in front of her clearly, but she couldn't resist the fatigue and sleepiness and fell into a deep sleep.

The next day, Song Ci slept until half past eleven.

She woke up in Zhu Yanzheng's room. When she woke up, there were clean and brand-new clothes beside her.

I can no longer buy last night's nightgown. The silk fabric is full of wrinkles and... unbearable.

The room has been tidied up, and all the clothes from inside to outside have been prepared for her.

After Song Ci got dressed and walked out of the room, she saw Zhu Yanzheng sitting in the living room, looking down at the newspaper.

He raised his eyebrows slightly.

Isn't today a working day?Zhu Yanzheng didn't go to the company?

The legs are still a little weak.

Song Ci stood on the stairs holding on to the handrail.

Hearing the movement, the man raised his eyes slightly and looked towards her.

The girl had finished washing and tidying up, her face was radiant and her face was rosy.
